description: Land Acquisition - Karuppankudyiruppu, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders for taking possession of described land parcels, including detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is incidental to the core land-related content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities described beyond the minister's title. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land acquisition, property boundaries, and land ownership matters.
